subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw support the public, activation-scoped `api.registerReadinessCriterion` Plugin SDK API and operator-selected `gateway.readiness` criteria in V1?
rationale: This is a new Plugin SDK and configuration compatibility contract, not a mechanical implementation choice; accepting it determines long-term ownership, support, and upgrade obligations.

options.title: Approve the full V1 contract
options.body: Accept public plugin readiness registration and operator-selected criteria as supported Plugin SDK and configuration surfaces.

options.title: Land core readiness first
options.body: Keep the canonical core evaluator and public projections, but defer plugin registration and selector identifiers to a separately approved SDK proposal.

recommendation.title: Land core readiness first
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical core evaluator and public projections, but defer plugin registration and selector identifiers to a separately approved SDK proposal.

likelyOwner.reason: The RFC and branch author is the best available routing contact to clarify the intended contract before a core maintainer makes the product decision.
